strict_reconstruction.description: Favor strongly evidenced period/region/role combinations; unknowns remain unknown; ask only when a missing detail changes the reconstruction materially.

historically_informed.description: Use evidence-backed anchors, allow plausible interpolation, and label interpretive details internally.

period_drama.description: Maintain a coherent period impression while allowing tasteful dramatic simplification or idealization.

fantasy_hybrid.description: Historical anchors may combine with explicit fantasy/genre overlays; never present invented elements as historical fact.
